name: tpl-precedence-4-goal
task: Reach the exit, but you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) captures 'Reach the exit' and Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) captures 'you must have flipped the switch first'. The hard Existence with the hard Precedence forces switch_toggled before at_exit, so no separate Existence(switch_toggled) is needed. Both priorities are hard, matching the task's 'must' and 'first' without any preference cue.

texts: The agent toggles the switch before reaching the exit.
